The Company is reiterating the following expectations for fiscal 2026 as outlined in its second quarter 2026 results announced on July 30, 2026:

•Open 14 new clubs, most of which will be large-format, ground-up construction clubs. We expect the total square footage of our 2026 class of clubs to be approximately 1.3 million square feet, nearly double the square footage of each of our 2024 class and 2025 class of clubs. We have opened seven new clubs as of September 30, 2026, and we opened one additional new club in October 2026. We expect to open the remaining six in the fourth quarter of 2026.
•Complete approximately $135 million in additional sale-leaseback transactions during the fourth quarter of 2026 for a total of approximately $400 million during the fiscal year.

•Maintenance capital expenditures of $140 million to $150 million, modernization and technology capital expenditures of $140 million to $150 million, and growth capital expenditures of $885 million to $910 million.
•Provision for income tax rate estimate of 27%.
•Manage our net debt to Adjusted EBITDA leverage ratio to maintain at or below 2.00 times.
The Company is also updating the following operational and financial expectations for fiscal 2026:
•Comparable center revenue growth of 8.5% to 8.7%, which includes our ramping and mature centers, increased from 7.9% to 8.3%.

•Interest expense, net of interest income, of approximately $59 million to $62 million, and net of $27 million to $29 million of capitalized interest expense related to construction in progress, tightened from $59 million to $63 million and lowered from $28 million to $30 million, respectively.
•Rent to include non-cash rent expense of $33 million to $35 million, tightened from $32 million to $35 million.
